_uaNote: Empty means: use the real Android WebView user agent, unspoofed.
A spoofed desktop UA claims an engine the WebView is not, and Instagram can
compare the UA string against the actual TLS/JA3 and JS-API fingerprint.
Set a value here only if you have verified login still completes.
_notes: Bundled fallback. The remote rules file at BuildConfig.RULES_URL takes precedence when set.
homeUrl must stay on instagram.com or over HTTPS; the loader rejects anything else.
allowPathPrefixes gates the route guard. Anything NOT listed is redirected to homeUrl
once an Instagram session cookie exists. Login and challenge paths must remain listed.
hideLabels are English-only and break under non-English locales. Prefer href rules.
blockedPathPrefixes returns HTTP 403 to Instagram's own calls. Keep it strictly to
telemetry. Do NOT block /async_critical_notices/ (that is the system Instagram uses to
surface 'Suspicious Login Attempt') or /api/v1/qe/ (client bootstrap config) -- blocking
either wedges the login SPA and the page just reloads forever.
